items.title: Daily Briefing
items.script: Here is your daily briefing. Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon reports continued investor interest in AI infrastructure despite recent declines in AI stock prices and political concerns about data centers. Prediction markets show low chances of Nvidia's CEO leaving soon. A startup called Nominal, which provides AI tools for hardware engineering, has increased its value three times to $3 billion in just eight months. Companies face challenges linking AI and cloud computing to reliable data and scientific expertise in the chemicals sector.
